interpretation: Diagnostics only. No model, checkpoint, or weight selection is performed; the locked primary and secondary decisions are unchanged. Overlapping origins share target days, so inference uses HAC and moving-block bootstrap only.

calibration.definition: Rank (Talagrand) diagnostics pool all locked origins, horizons, and state dimensions. Pool diagnostics use the same per-seed 20-path ensembles the locked score averages over. Energy terms use the same sqrt(H*d) normalization as the state energy score: energy = distance_to_observation - 0.5 * spread.
